title: Ship the runner references in the ticfac skill and install it in the orchestrator image
body: Since ticks v0.32.0 the ticks skill the image installs has no agent-runner/herdr-runner references, and ticfac's copies live in internal/runconfig of ticfac's own repo, which an orchestrator container working another repository cannot read. The entrypoint's fallback prompts (reboot/default/herdr guidance) now name that contract but nothing in the container carries it. Put the references under skills/ticfac/references (embedded via go:embed all:skills) and install the ticfac skill in image/Dockerfile beside the ticks one, then point the prompts at the installed path.
